summary: Meir is a Melbourne (Albion) premium tapware brand running Acumatica and Shopify, which won the 2025 MYOB Acumatica Business Breakthrough Award and has grown fast, including a Sept 2025 partnership with Nood Co. Kamal Bapna is the confirmed current Finance Manager (CPA, FX management background). The listed primary contact, Maddie Collins, could not be confirmed at Meir, but she is the only contact with an email (Kamal Bapna has none), so drafts go to Maddie.

Kamal's FX management background plus a business growing fast across 14 countries.
New Inventory and Fulfilment Controller role signals stock/working-capital tightening and Acumatica as source of truth.
Sales up 85% and the Nood Co partnership mean more stockist transactions to match each month.

Partnership with Nood Co (Sept 2025) may bring structure or finance changes.

first.subject: Acumatica and the reconciliation layer at Meir
first.body:
Hi Maddie,

Meir winning the MYOB Acumatica Business Breakthrough Award for 2025, with Acumatica credited for saving over 30% in admin time, tells me your team has already automated a lot. What usually stays manual is the layer around it: Shopify payouts, stockist receipts and FX. I built Vert to take reconciliation and cash coding from hours to minutes, with every match traceable. How much of your month-end still sits in spreadsheets outside Acumatica?

Best,
Dawoud
